soundness_flags.label: def:probability-integral-gauge and all results using baseline_gauge
soundness_flags.one_line: The reference measure for q_i^e is unstated: if q is a lambda-density as the Hellinger and Radon--Nikodym conventions imply, beta_i(t)=2pi integral_0^t q_i^0(s)ds does not generally descend to a circle diffeomorphism; state the density convention and correct the normalization.

soundness_flags.one_line: Rot(alpha_h(x))x and |x| are not specified for general n: a full n-dimensional radial rotation and a two-coordinate rotation have different supports and Hellinger/L2 scalings, so the claimed n-uniform powers are not presently defined.

soundness_flags.one_line: Omega_{k,m}^{rad} is only given a signature and no restricted supremum/class, while “all bounded C^k radial volume-preserving twists” lacks a precise plane, support, norm, and quotient definition.

soundness_flags.label: def:certified-spectral-estimator / thm:certified-spectral-recovery
soundness_flags.one_line: The estimator clips observed Fourier densities at c0/2 although c0 bounds latent densities; a K-bi-Lipschitz decoder permits observed density below c0/2, so this sieve can exclude the true law and invalidate the asserted uniform rate.
